body.content: Re-verify the prime p^20 case: 2^20 = 1,048,576. Since n < 10,000, m < 12,005. 1,048,576 >> 12,005. This case is definitely impossible. The logic for p^6 * q^2 is the only viable path. Let's ensure no other factor combinations for 21 exist. Only (21,1) and (7,3) are pairs that multiply to 21. So exponents must be {20} or {6, 2}. The search for m in [2006, 12004] is exhaustive.
body.why_keep_this: Confirms the constraints on prime factorization for d(m)=21.
